title: The Godfather
synopsis: A wedding. A horse's head. A war between five families. You're the youngest son. The family business is, finally, calling you.

nodes.text: Connie's wedding. Sicilians believe no Sicilian can refuse a request on a wedding day. Your father takes meetings in a dark study.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Distance—follows you into whatever comes next.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Observe.

nodes.text: Kay asks who that man is. You tell her. You tell her, then, that this isn't your life.

choices.consequence: “Mean it” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Naive.
“Half-mean it” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Honest.

nodes.text: A man named Solozzo wants the family in the heroin business. Your father says no. You realize the word 'no' has a price.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Respect.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Modern.

nodes.text: Your father has been shot. The hospital is empty of guards. You stand in his room alone.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Improvise protection.” The story records the instinct as “Brave” and carries it forward.
There is no taking “Call Sonny first” back. Process shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: McCluskey breaks your jaw. The family is, suddenly, at war with a captain of police.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Plan revenge cold” back. Strategic shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Hot.

nodes.text: Solozzo and McCluskey. Italian restaurant. Gun taped behind the toilet. The walls hum.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Do it” back. Cross shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Refuse.

nodes.text: You hide in Sicily. The hills are beautiful. You meet Apollonia. You realize you can almost have a different life.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Heart—follows you into whatever comes next.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Mind—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: Apollonia is killed by a bomb meant for you. You stand by the wreckage. Something inside closes for good.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Vow vengeance” back. Sicilian shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Strategic.

nodes.text: Back in New York. Kay waits. You ask her to trust you. She does, with conditions.

choices.text: Promise the family will go legitimate
choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Lie kindly.
There is no taking “Promise nothing” back. Honest shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: Sonny is killed on a tollbooth highway, riddled. Your father, broken, sits with you in the garden.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Heir.
There is no taking “Stay in the shadows” back. Power shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: Your father, old, asks for a meeting of the five families. He brokers peace. He gets to live, briefly.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Watch him lead” back. Learn shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Equal.

nodes.text: Tom, consigliere, briefs you. You realize Tessio has betrayed the family.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Patient.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Speed.

nodes.text: You marry Kay. The ceremony is in English. Your father, at the reception, dances with her.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Honor him” back. Son shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Don.

nodes.text: Your father, retired, plays with your son in the tomato garden. He dies there, peacefully. You hold his hand last.

choices.text: Promise him to honor the family
choices.consequence: “Promise him to honor the family” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Vow.
“Promise yourself to be different” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Modern.

nodes.text: Tom and you, in the kitchen, plan the strike. Every head of every family. One day. The same day Connie's son is baptized.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Cold—follows you into whatever comes next.
There is no taking “Spare one” back. Mercy shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: You renounce Satan in the church. At the same moment, across the city, your enemies fall.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Self-deceit—follows you into whatever comes next.
“Don't mean it” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Honest.

nodes.text: Carlo, who betrayed Sonny, sits in your car. He weeps. He admits it. You let him die.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Tell yourself it was justice.” The story records the instinct as “Story” and carries it forward.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Cold—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: Kay asks if you killed Connie's husband. You look her in the eye and lie.

choices.consequence: “Tell the kindest lie” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Marriage.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Don.

nodes.text: The family men kiss your hand. They call you Don. Kay sees through a doorway. The door closes.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Witness.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Power.

nodes.text: You have built an empire. You have buried friends. Your son will not know what you have done. You have, you tell yourself, done it for him.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Story.
There is no taking “Don't believe it” back. Truth shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: You sit in your father's chair. The chair fits, now. You decide what kind of Don you are going to be.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Power.
There is no taking “The fair one” back. Honor shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
Some endings reveal themselves last.

nodes.text: You rule for thirty years. The family is feared and quiet. Kay leaves, eventually. Your children grow up American, ignorant. You are alone with the work.
Over twenty years you move the family into Vegas, real estate, banks. Your grandchildren are senators. The history is, by then, forgivable.
You die in a tomato garden, old, with a grandchild on your knee. The Don you became, in the end, was kinder than the one you intended. You take that as a small, final victory.
